info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Security & Access
info.description:
Security and access control configuration from Cisco-IOS-XE-native model.

**Includes:** tacacs, tacacs-server, radius, radius-server, dot1x, eap, mab, identity, cts, device-tracking, device-sensor, password, enable, login, privilege, mka

**Modules covered:** Cisco-IOS-XE-device-sensor (device profiling)

**Key Features:**
- TACACS+ authentication
- RADIUS authentication
- 802.1X port security
- MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB)
- Identity services
- TrustSec (CTS)
- Device tracking & sensor
- Password and privilege management

**Base Path:** `/data/Cisco-IOS-XE-native:native/`

**Related:** See 'AAA' for authentication/authorization/accounting

get.description:
Retrieve device sensor (profiling) configuration for automatic device classification.

CLI equivalent: `show running-config | section device-sensor`

YANG module: Cisco-IOS-XE-device-sensor

Device sensor collects DHCP, CDP, and LLDP attributes from endpoints to build device profiles for policy decisions.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Limit the depth of returned sub-tree data (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.2). Use 'unbounded' for full depth.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Select specific fields to return (RFC 8040 Section 4.8.3). Example: fields=name;status

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Filter by config state: 'config' (config true only), 'nonconfig' (config false only), or 'all'.

patch.description: Merge update to device sensor configuration.
